source.kind: independent teaching-course mirror; exact identity to original publication unresolved
source.sample_count_conflict: educational mirror 44 accession / 879 rows; paper reports 38 accession / 760 plants and mentions exclusion of six accessions in fitted analyses; not byte crosswalked

pre_outcome_locked.holdout: leave-one-complete-rack/replicate-out (5 folds, same known accession codes)
pre_outcome_locked.P0: mean outcome within water×microbe treatment from training rows
pre_outcome_locked.P1: P0 + shrunken accession mean residual; pseudocount 10
pre_outcome_locked.primary_score: MSE(P1)-MSE(P2) in transformed fruit units, positive = improvement
pre_outcome_locked.positive_gate: nonnegative on all five heldout racks; positive equal-accession mean; lower conditional accession-bootstrap 95% interval>0; positive in >=3/4 treatment contexts

main_result.status: exploratory predictive gain on this teaching mirror only
main_result.independently_recomputed: Python GitHub Actions and separate JS implementation agreed to display precision on Git-blob-verified source

post_result_sensitivity.rationale: center accession-specific treatment corrections to zero mean weighted by training rows, to avoid the P2 layer merely updating P1 accession intercept
post_result_sensitivity.interpretation: post-result action-only sensitivity, not a second independent experiment or confirmatory test

scientific_limits: Related published study already establishes drought×microbe×genetic-lineage fitness differences; this is not novel G×E.
Educational copy and original Dryad publication not byte-verified identical.
Accession identifiers are not measured SNP variants or genome structure.
Fruit count is not lifetime seed fitness.
Shared accession identities across five rack folds; cannot generalize to unseen genotypes or unrelated sites.
Accession bootstrap interval conditions on fixed crossvalidated prediction, not new independent plants.
P2 uncentered additionally corrects P1 accession intercept shrinkage; stronger action-only centered result is post-result.
No non-nested ecological source–target replacement relation, carried label map or route coherence was estimated.
